entry: Q Pitch Q tells the Capital Q story in its own voice. What it shows of the product uses fictional demonstration data, labelled as such. You can pause, go back, skip, start over or ask a question at any point, by voice or by typing. You can also ask Q from any page: "Hey Q, pitch yourself", or "pitch yourself to investors" or "to founders". Who is it for? Everyone About 7 minutes Start Investors Under 4 minutes Start Founders About 4½ minutes Start

ask.q: What cheque range does my mandate allow?
ask.reply: Q: Your mandate allows cheques of USD 250,000 to USD 1,000,000, with USD 600,000 as the typical cheque. Sources Investor · 1 Ask Q Q Opened Discover View
